onboarding.welcomeReadAloud: Barka da zuwa Haske ga Duniya ta wurin Kalmar Allah. Danna Fara don ci gaba.
onboarding.talkbackBody: Aikace-aikacen yana aiki mafi kyau idan an kunna na'urar karanta allo. Za ka iya kunna TalkBack a cikin saitunan wayarka a kowane lokaci.
onboarding.talkbackReadAloud: Wannan shafi yana nuna yadda ake kunna TalkBack. Za ka iya tsallakewa a kowane lokaci.
onboarding.languageReadAloud: Zabi harshenka. Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, ko Turanci.

home.offlineReadingIn: Ba kan layi ba, ana karatu cikin {{language}}
home.tapToSpeak: Danna don yin magana da umarni
